end.summary:
Practised linking harvest festivals to the season when crops are ready.
Identified that different regions celebrate different festivals in different ways.
Kavya named Diwali, Onam, Bihu, Makar Sankranti, Christmas and Holi.
The mix-up about festivals happening at any time was corrected by connecting them to crop seasons.
Regional celebration details included new clothes, sweets and rangoli, but the full description task was not completed unaided.
end.parentNote: Asha practised harvest seasons, regional festivals, and how celebrations can differ by place. Kavya used the crop-season idea correctly after initially mixing up festival timing, and gave examples such as new clothes, sweets, rangoli and different foods. At home, ask Kavya to describe one festival using four headings: food, clothes, decorations and flowers.
